documentation.content:
API request latency over the last 15 minutes is above target: p95 > 2 s or p99 > 5 s. Excludes SSE /stream and /internal/* (from the request log, api_request_latency); needs at least 20 requests. One PromQL condition (Cloud Monitoring allows only one per PromQL policy).

Runbook: [backend/infra/runbooks.md#high-latency](https://github.com/Dawn-Of-Justice/bharat-sourcer/blob/main/backend/infra/runbooks.md#high-latency)

Specs: backend/infra/monitoring/, guide: backend/infra/monitoring.md

conditions.displayName: API p95 latency > 2 s or p99 > 5 s over 15 min

conditionPrometheusQueryLanguage.query: ((histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(logging_googleapis_com:user_api_request_latency_bucket{monitored_resource="cloud_run_revision"}[15m]))) > 2) or (histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(logging_googleapis_com:user_api_request_latency_bucket{monitored_resource="cloud_run_revision"}[15m]))) > 5)) and on() (sum(increase(logging_googleapis_com:user_api_request_latency_count{monitored_resource="cloud_run_revision"}[15m])) >= 20)
